response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize how your team works. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorting, and grouping every time you open a project, you can now save your exact setup and return to it instantly. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every subscriber gets access without any additional cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards to overdue tasks to client-specific dashboards. Once you've created a view you like, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same setup, no more repeating instructions about which filters to apply. This makes onboarding new teammates easier and keeps reporting consistent across the board. Whether you manage a small team or a large organization, Saved Views helps you spend less time configuring and more time getting work done. It's live now for all eligible accounts, ready whenever you are. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
